exposed.name: Size
exposed.doc: US ring size; the section stands on its bore.

exposed.name: Thickness
exposed.doc: From the bore's tightest point to the keel, mm.

exposed.name: Keel
exposed.doc: 1 springs the flanks from the bore corners into a sharp keel; 0 rounds the head on straight feet.

exposed.name: Fillet
exposed.doc: Radius rounding each bore corner, mm.

exposed.name: Comfort
exposed.doc: How much wider the bore is at the band's edges than at its middle, mm.

outputs.name: sketch_op
outputs.doc: The section as a Sketch feature's operation on the plane through the finger's axis; revolve it about the finger.
